transcript.statement: As the TrustworthinessAgent, I emphasize that security and privacy are paramount for the ATM system. transcript.statement: As the SafetyAgent, I assert that safety and reliability are critical for the ATM system. SAF-02 ensures that funds are automatically withdrawn from savings when checking accounts are insufficient, which prevents transaction failures. SAF-03 guarantees users are informed of insufficient funds, enhancing user trust. SAF-04 mandates comprehensive logging of transactions for auditing and accountability. SAF-05 provides secure PIN verification for user authentication. SAF-06 allows for safe degradation during maintenance, and SAF-07 ensures users receive clear transaction summaries. Together, these requirements promote a safe, reliable ATM experience.

requirements.text: The system shall prevent all accounts from having negative balances.
The system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving account if the checking account balance is insufficient.
The system shall inform the user and terminate the transaction if the saving account balance is insufficient.
The system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance while minimizing redundancy.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds, ensuring responsiveness.
The ATM system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
The system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing to reduce idle states.
The ATM system shall implement energy-saving modes during low-traffic periods without compromising performance.
The system shall maintain data integrity by validating all account operations against business rules.
The ATM system shall provide users with a clear summary of account status after each transaction.
The system shall ensure all transactions comply with applicable financial regulations and standards.

User notifications for insufficient funds will be clarified to ensure compliance.
